role: Defines BaselineSnapshot (a Codable cached baseline value with timestamp) and RespiratoryBaselineCache, a UserDefaults-backed 30-day last-known-good 7-day respiratory-rate baseline used when HealthKit is unreachable (locked phone).
types: BaselineSnapshot: struct — Codable value/sampleCount/lastUpdated; shared shape for respiratory and wrist-temperature caches
RespiratoryBaselineCache: enum — static read/write/clear over UserDefaults
toplevel: The long doc comment describing RespiratoryBaselineCache (lines 3-19) is attached to BaselineSnapshot because the BaselineSnapshot doc comment follows it with no blank line before struct (line 20-23); cosmetic.

flags.text: BaselineSnapshot.sampleCount is never populated: both write(value:sampleCount:) callers pass only value (VitalsHealthQueries+Queries.swift:113,262) so it is always 0, and no reader uses sampleCount (callers read only .value).

Doc comment says every successful HK baseline fetch from any caller writes the cache; the writers only write when referenceDate is today (refreshesBaselineCache), so reanalysis of past nights never refreshes it.

units.does: Reads Data at UserDefaults.standard[key], JSON-decodes a BaselineSnapshot and returns it unless it is older than maxAgeSeconds measured from Date() now.

branches.cond: no data under key, or JSON decode fails (try?)
branches.effect: returns nil; decode error swallowed silently (no log), else continue

branches.cond: snapshot lastUpdated more than maxAgeSeconds before now

flags.text: Age is measured against wall-clock now, not the reference date being scored; a reanalysis of an old session (fetchRespiratoryRateBaseline(relativeTo:) with HK unreachable) gets whatever baseline was cached in the last 30 days, not one near that session.

units.does: Returns the cached respiratory baseline snapshot (<=30 days old) via BaselineSnapshot.read.
Encodes a new BaselineSnapshot(value, sampleCount, now) and stores it under RespiratoryBaselineCache.v1. Called from VitalsHealthQueries+Queries.swift:113 after a successful live HK baseline query.

branches.effect: true: data written to UserDefaults; false: encode error logged by attempt and nothing written

units.does: Removes RespiratoryBaselineCache.v1 from UserDefaults. Called by DataPurgeService.swift:701.
